title: Wild AG media frame
description: A media slot that crops an image or video like object-fit cover, with a plain sand placeholder when empty. In 'fixed' mode the footage stays put in the window while its frame scrolls past, so the frame acts as a window onto still footage.
notes: fixed mode clips a position:fixed layer with clip-path; an ancestor with a transform or filter turns it back into an ordinary frame
size, radius and position come from className
